full_judgment:
Md Fazlul Karim J: This petition for leave to appeal at the instance of the defendant No. 3 Principal of the College concerned is directed against the impugned order of the High Court Division summarily rejecting the revisional application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure against the judgment and decree of the Court of appeal below decreeing the suit reversing those of the trial Court dismissing the suit. 

 2. The suit has been filed by the plaintiffs asserting that they are the founders of the college and accordingly, representing from the category of founder member in the managing Committee on being elected from the quota of the founder. The college has refused the plaintiffs from allowing to contest the election alleging that they were not founders of the college and thereby rejected their nominations. The suit was contested by the petitioner alleging that the plaintiffs could not fulfill the requirements to be the founders. The trial Court dismissed the suit and on appeal the suit was decreed holding that the plaintiffs were elected as founder representatives even in 1973 from the category of the founders when the College was a private institution. The contribution made by the plaintiffs at earlier stage of the college could not be ignored and the same has not been denied by the defendant.
